name: f4-curv-depth-kpi-orig-characteristics
description: DB reader/writer for the F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_ORIG_CHARACTERISTICS (F4) skill: computes the Curvature Depth Index (CDIx, unweighted and weighted) between a person's own observed, normalized profile z(t) (F1_GDX_SKILL_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_FEATURE_SPACE's own output) and an explicit, frozen reference profile, and records the result into the GDX_HNF_CDI_* tables, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
